definition: GPUs in a complete independently repeatable group.

definition: Peak memory required on each GPU in the reference configuration.
method: Measure the busiest device with GPU telemetry during representative work. Include weights, working state and buffers. Record the source and margin.

method: Use a matching measured run or an explicit engineering assumption for this platform. Do not silently translate throughput measured on another GPU.

method: Measure directional read and write payload peaks. Capacity alone cannot determine bandwidth.

method: Use GPU communication telemetry and an agreed RTT objective.

definition: Accepted network defaults. Storage networking is physically dedicated.
method: Review usable bandwidth and whether loading coincides with normal operation.
